newsitem.title: USA: Summit/investors buy 6.4 pct Payless stake.
newsitem.headline: Summit/investors buy 6.4 pct Payless stake.

text.p: Summit Capital Appreciation Fund LP and several other investors acquired 2,403,600 shares of common stock of Payless Cashways Inc, or about 6.4 percent, a spokesman for the group said on Monday.

"We intend to be active stockholders," Marc Kozberg, the spokesman for the group, said in a statement. "We feel that the company is fundamentally sound, but we are concerned the board of directors has not exhibited the leadership necessary to enhance shareholder value."
Kozberg said his group may seek Board representation and has obtained a list of stockholders to communicate directly with them in the future.
He said members of the group may buy additional stock in Payless.
Kozberg said the acquired stock was for investment purposes and emphasized that the group believed Payless Cashways to be significantly undervalued.
Payless Cashways, a retailer of building materials and home improvement products, was not immediately available for comment.
Later, Payless spokeswoman Brenda Nolte said the company has not received a request for board representation, but will forward it to the governance committee if one is made.
"We have met with Mr. Kozberg on a number of occasions and we plan to keep the lines of communications open," Nolte said. "That is our practice, to have ongoing conversations with our shareholders."
